plugin.name: HukoDB_Vault
plugin.author: HukoDB
plugin.purpose: Runs the in-game vault: accounts, deposits, balances and payouts for the casino
plugin.description:
.------------------.
| HukoDB Vault |
`------------------'
Park HukoDB at a bank and leave this plugin loaded. Players then:
tell HukoDB login - makes an account, tells them a password
tell HukoDB reset - new password if they lost it
tell HukoDB balance - gold in their account
tell HukoDB withdraw 5000 - pays gold out of their account
tell HukoDB pay - collects a payout requested on the site (needs a bank)
tell HukoDB refund - returns gold held for them
tell HukoDB help
Gold sent to HukoDB by GIVE or BANK TRANSFER is credited to the sender's
account. If they have no account the gold is held and they are offered a
refund (the bank fee is deducted from a bank refund).
Payouts can only leave by bank transfer, which means HukoDB has to be
standing in a bank when they are sent. Requests wait in the queue until
then: a transfer that cannot be made is never refunded and never marked
paid, so a run from the wrong room costs nothing and is simply repeated
from a bank.
Local (operator) commands:
vault secret <value> - set the bot secret from schema-casino.sql
vault status - secret loaded? queue length? debug?
vault debug - toggle line logging
vault flush - retry the upload queue now
vault payall - pay every queued payout in one go (needs a bank)
stops cleanly on "not in a bank" or "bank short",
leaving every unpaid request queued
vault void <ref> - refund one request the bank can never send
vault audit - reconcile payouts against the ledger
vault verify - check the event log hash chain
vault check <char> - account, lifetime, balance check, last 20 events
vault spins <char> [n] - a character's recent spin results
vault ref WD-XXXXXX - one withdrawal request and its events
vault errors - recent bot errors (also HukoDB_vault.log)
vault test - send the secret and show what the server says
vault bankall - bank all carried gold (needs a full session)
vault last - the last gold lines the plugin parsed
vault help

trigger.match: (?i)(\w+) has transferred ([\d,]+) gold into your (.+) bank account

muclient.script:
require "wait"
local json = require("json")
local ltn12 = require("ltn12")
local ok_ssl, https = pcall(require, "ssl.https")
-- ============================================================
-- SETTINGS
-- ============================================================
local VAULT = {
url = "https://dnklaemuuqckoriotrcv.supabase.co",
anon = "sb_publishable_kp8O84wZUwzqEc2o8YTbxA_yiZVy3LV",
bot_name = "HukoDB",
owner = "Huko",
min_withdraw = 1000,
max_move = 100000000,
fee_pct = 1, -- match your bank's transfer rate (see: bank info)
fee_flat = 0,
debug = false
}
local SECRET = ""
local queue = {} -- deposits the website has not confirmed yet
local BUILD = "2026-11-20h"
local seen = {} -- dedupe repeated give/receive lines
local recent = {} -- last gold lines seen, for 'vault last'
local function remember(text)
table.insert(recent, os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. " " .. text)
if #recent > 8 then table.remove(recent, 1) end
end
local lastGive = nil -- a give we are waiting on the room check for
-- ============================================================
-- SMALL HELPERS
-- ============================================================
local function trim(s)
return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end
local function fmt(n)
local s = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0))
local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
return (out:gsub("^,", ""))
end
local function amountOf(s)
s = tostring(s or ""):gsub(",", "")
local n = tonumber(s)
if not n or n ~= n or n < 1 then return nil end
return math.floor(n)
end
local function note(text, colour)
ColourNote(colour or "silver", "black", "[Vault] " .. text)
end
-- Recent problems, kept in memory and appended to HukoDB_vault.log.
local errors = {}
local function errorLog(message)
local stamp = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
local line = stamp .. " " .. tostring(message)
table.insert(errors, line)
if #errors > 200 then table.remove(errors, 1) end
local dir = GetInfo(67) or ""
local f = io.open(dir .. "HukoDB_vault.log", "a")
if f then
f:write(line .. "\n")
f:close()
end
end
local function tell(name, text)
Send("tell " .. name .. " " .. text)
end
local function feeFor(amount)
local fee = math.floor(amount * VAULT.fee_pct / 100) + VAULT.fee_flat
if fee < 0 then fee = 0 end
return fee
end
local function randomPassword()
local chars = "abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
local out = {}
for i = 1, 10 do
local n = math.random(1, #chars)
out[i] = chars:sub(n, n)
end
return table.concat(out)
end
local refSeq = 0
local function newRef(prefix)
-- os.time() is only second-accurate, so two deposits from one player in
-- the same second used to share a random ref. casino_deposit treats a
-- repeated ref as a replay and returns the first answer, which silently
-- swallowed the second deposit. The counter keeps every ref unique.
refSeq = refSeq + 1
return prefix .. "-" .. tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(refSeq) ..
"-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
end
local function secret()
if SECRET == "" then SECRET = trim(GetVariable("bot_secret")) end
return SECRET
end
local function loadSecretFromFile()
if secret() ~= "" then return true end
local dir = GetInfo(67) or ""
local paths = {
dir .. "HukoDB_secret.txt",
dir .. "plugins/HukoDB_secret.txt",
"HukoDB_secret.txt"
}
for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
local f = io.open(path, "r")
if f then
local value = trim(f:read("*a"))
f:close()
if value ~= "" then
SECRET = value
SetVariable("bot_secret", value)
SaveState()
note("Secret loaded from " .. path, "lime")
return true
end
end
end
return false
end
-- ============================================================
-- WEBSITE
-- ============================================================
local function rpc(fn, args)
if not ok_ssl then return nil, "ssl.https unavailable" end
local body = json.encode(args)
local response = {}
local ok, code = https.request({
url = VAULT.url .. "/rest/v1/rpc/" .. fn,
method = "POST",
protocol = "tlsv1_2",
headers = {
["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
["Content-Length"] = tostring(#body),
["apikey"] = VAULT.anon,
["Authorization"] = VAULT.anon:sub(1, 3) ~= "sb_" and ("Bearer " .. VAULT.anon) or nil
},
source = ltn12.source.string(body),
sink = ltn12.sink.table(response)
})
local text = table.concat(response)
if VAULT.debug then
note(fn .. " -> " .. tostring(code) .. " " .. tostring(text), "grey")
end
if not ok then return nil, "network" end
local parsed
local decoded, data = pcall(json.decode, text)
if decoded and type(data) == "table" then parsed = data end
if code ~= 200 then
local message = parsed and (parsed.message or parsed.error) or ("HTTP " .. tostring(code))
return nil, message
end
if not parsed then return nil, "bad reply" end
return parsed
end
local function rpcRetry(fn, args, tries)
tries = tries or 3
local last
for attempt = 1, tries do
local result, err = rpc(fn, args)
if result then return result end
last = err
if attempt < tries then wait.time(1.5) end
end
return nil, last
end
-- ============================================================
-- OUTBOX: deposits the website did not confirm
-- ============================================================
local function persistQueue()
SetVariable("outbox", json.encode(queue))
end
local function saveQueue()
persistQueue()
SaveState()
end
local function loadQueue()
queue = {}
local raw = GetVariable("outbox")
if raw and raw ~= "" then
local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw)
if ok and type(data) == "table" then
for _, item in ipairs(data) do
if type(item) == "table" and item.name and item.amount then
table.insert(queue, item)
end
end
end
end
end
local function queueAdd(name, amount, method, ref, bank)
table.insert(queue, { name = name, amount = amount, method = method, ref = ref, bank = bank })
saveQueue()
end
-- Assumes it is already running inside a wait.make coroutine.
local function flushQueue()
if #queue == 0 or secret() == "" then return end
local remaining = {}
for _, item in ipairs(queue) do
local result = rpcRetry("casino_deposit", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = item.name, p_amount = item.amount,
p_method = item.method, p_ref = item.ref, p_bank = item.bank
})
if result and result.ok then
if result.status == "credited" then
tell(item.name, fmt(item.amount) .. " gold added to " .. result.character .. "'s account.")
if item.method ~= "bank" then Send("bank deposit " .. tostring(item.amount)) end
else
tell(item.name, "You don't have an account. Tell me 'login' to make one, or 'refund' to get it back (bank fee deducted).")
end
else
table.insert(remaining, item)
end
end
queue = remaining
saveQueue()
end
function vaultFlush()
if #queue == 0 or secret() == "" then return end
wait.make(function() flushQueue() end)
end
function vaultFlushNow()
if secret() == "" then note("No secret set. Use: vault secret <value>", "orange"); return end
note("Retrying " .. #queue .. " queued transfer(s)...")
vaultFlush()
end
-- ============================================================
-- TELLS
-- ============================================================
local function parseTell(line)
local low = line:lower()
local start, finish = low:find("tells you")
if not start then return nil end
local name = line:sub(1, start - 1):match("([%w]+)%s*$")
if not name then return nil end
local rest = line:sub(finish + 1)
rest = rest:gsub("^[%s,:-]+", "")
rest = rest:gsub('^"', ""):gsub('"$', "")
rest = rest:gsub("^'", ""):gsub("'$", "")
return name, trim(rest)
end
function vaultTell(name, line)
if not line then return end
local speaker, message = parseTell(line)
if not speaker then return end
if speaker:lower() == VAULT.bot_name:lower() then return end
if VAULT.debug then note("tell from " .. speaker .. ": " .. message, "grey") end
local command, rest = message:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
command = (command or ""):lower()
rest = trim(rest)
-- A tell that arrives while the vault is not connected to the site is
-- answered honestly rather than silently dropped.
if secret() == "" then
note("Tell from " .. speaker .. " ignored: no bot secret set.", "orange")
return
end
if command == "login" or command == "register" then
doLogin(speaker)
elseif command == "reset" or command == "password" then
doReset(speaker)
elseif command == "balance" or command == "bal" or command == "gold" then
doBalance(speaker)
elseif command == "withdraw" or command == "with" then
doWithdraw(speaker, rest)
elseif command == "pay" or command == "collect" then
doPay(speaker, rest)
elseif command == "refund" then
doRefund(speaker)
elseif command == "help" then
tell(speaker, "login, balance, withdraw <gold>, pay, refund, help.")
end
end
function doLogin(speaker)
wait.make(function()
-- Ask the vault to generate the password with gen_random_bytes. Lua's
-- math.random is a seeded LCG: every password came from one shared
-- stream, so seeing a few outputs helped predict other players'.
local result, err = rpcRetry("casino_register", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker
})
local password = result and result.password
local no_param = (not result and (tostring(err):find("PGRST202") or
tostring(err):lower():find("could not find the function")))
or (result and not result.ok and result.error == "password")
if no_param then
-- Schema without server-side generation: fall back to a local one.
password = randomPassword()
result, err = rpcRetry("casino_register", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker, p_password = password
})
end
if not result then
tell(speaker, "The vault is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.")
note("register failed: " .. tostring(err), "red")
errorLog("register failed for " .. speaker .. ": " .. tostring(err))
return
end
if not result.ok then
if result.error == "exists" then
tell(speaker, "You already have an account. Tell me 'reset' if you forgot the password.")
elseif result.error == "name" then
tell(speaker, "That character name cannot be used for an account.")
else
tell(speaker, "Could not make the account. Try again shortly.")
note("register error: " .. tostring(result.error), "red")
end
return
end
tell(speaker, "Account made. Password: " .. password .. " - log in at hukodb.com/casino.html")
if (tonumber(result.pending) or 0) > 0 then
tell(speaker, fmt(result.pending) .. " gold added to " .. result.character .. "'s account.")
end
note("account created for " .. result.character, "lime")
end)
end
function doReset(speaker)
wait.make(function()
local result, err = rpcRetry("casino_set_password", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker
})
local password = result and result.password
local no_param = (not result and (tostring(err):find("PGRST202") or
tostring(err):lower():find("could not find the function")))
or (result and not result.ok and result.error == "password")
if no_param then
password = randomPassword()
result, err = rpcRetry("casino_set_password", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker, p_password = password
})
end
if not result then
tell(speaker, "The vault is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.")
return
end
if result.ok then
tell(speaker, "New password: " .. password)
note("password reset for " .. speaker, "yellow")
elseif result.error == "no_account" then
tell(speaker, "You don't have an account yet. Tell me 'login'.")
else
tell(speaker, "Could not reset the password. Try again shortly.")
note("reset failed: " .. tostring(err or result.error), "red")
end
end)
end
function doBalance(speaker)
wait.make(function()
local result = rpcRetry("casino_account_info", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker
})
if not result then
tell(speaker, "The vault is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.")
return
end
if result.ok then
tell(speaker, fmt(result.gold) .. " gold in your account.")
elseif result.error == "no_account" then
tell(speaker, "You don't have an account yet. Tell me 'login'.")
else
tell(speaker, "Could not read your balance. Try again shortly.")
end
end)
end
local function failPayout(row)
local v = rpcRetry("casino_payout_void", { p_secret = secret(), p_id = row.id })
if v and v.ok then
note("payout " .. tostring(row.ref) .. " not sent, refunded " .. fmt(v.amount or row.amount), "orange")
else
errorLog("payout void FAILED for " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " ..
tostring(v and v.error or "no answer") .. " - refund by hand")
note("COULD NOT REFUND " .. tostring(row.ref) .. " - refund by hand", "red")
end
end
-- Send the net the site recorded, wait for the game to confirm the transfer,
-- and only then settle that request. Gold that did not move is never
-- reported as paid.
--
-- Transfers only work with HukoDB standing in a bank, which is not every
-- session, so a transfer that cannot be made leaves the request exactly as
-- it was: still queued, never refunded. It is paid by a later run made from
-- a bank. 'vault void <ref>' is the only thing that refunds one.
-- What the bank can say back. The two refusals are worth telling apart:
-- "You can't do that here." / "You can only use the BANK command at a
-- banking location." -> HukoDB is not standing in a bank
-- "Transferring [N] gp would be impossible, as you only have [M] gp in
-- this account." -> the bank balance is short
-- Anything else is silence, which is treated as unknown: never a refund.
local BANK_WAIT = [[^(?:You transfer \[?([\d,]+)\]? gp to |Transferring \[?([\d,]+)\]? gp would be impossible, as you only have \[?([\d,]+)\]? gp|You can only use the BANK command at a banking location|You can't do that here\.)]]
local function goldOf(text)
return tonumber((tostring(text or ""):gsub(",", ""))) or 0
end
local function settlePayout(row, recipient)
local net = tonumber(row.net) or 0
-- Claim the request on the server before any gold moves. A player can only
-- cancel a request that is still "requested", so this closes the window
-- where someone cancelled (and was refunded) while the transfer was in
-- flight, ending up with both the gold and the refund.
local claim, claimErr = rpcRetry("casino_payout_claim", { p_secret = secret(), p_id = row.id })
if not claim then
local why = tostring(claimErr or "")
local legacy = why:find("PGRST202") or why:lower():find("could not find the function")
if not legacy then
note("PAYOUT NOT CLAIMED " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": the vault did not answer. Left queued.", "orange")
errorLog("payout claim failed " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " .. why)
return false, "notclaimed"
end
elseif not claim.ok then
note("PAYOUT NOT CLAIMED " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " .. tostring(claim.error or "?") ..
". Left queued.", "orange")
return false, "notclaimed"
end
-- Hand the request back if nothing left the bank, so it can be cancelled.
local function release()
rpc("casino_payout_release", { p_secret = secret(), p_id = row.id })
end
Send("bank transfer " .. tostring(net) .. " " .. recipient)
local matched, w = wait.regexp(BANK_WAIT, 10)
if not matched or not w then
local ctx = ""
if GetRecentLines then ctx = GetRecentLines(8) or "" end
note("PAYOUT NOT MADE " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": the game did not confirm the transfer. " ..
"Left queued, nothing refunded.", "orange")
errorLog("payout not made " .. tostring(row.ref) .. " (" .. fmt(net) .. " to " .. recipient ..
"): no transfer confirmation in 10s. Left queued, no refund. Recent output:\n" .. ctx)
release()
return false, "notsent"
end
local got = goldOf(w[1])
local wanted = goldOf(w[2])
local have = goldOf(w[3])
if got == 0 and wanted == 0 then
note("PAYOUT NOT MADE " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " .. VAULT.bot_name ..
" is not in a bank, so the bank refused. Still queued, nothing refunded.", "orange")
errorLog("payout not made " .. tostring(row.ref) .. " (" .. fmt(net) .. " to " .. recipient ..
"): not at a banking location. Request left queued.")
release()
return false, "notbank"
end
if got == 0 then
note("PAYOUT NOT MADE " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": the bank is short - asked for " ..
fmt(wanted) .. " gp and the account holds " .. fmt(have) .. ". Still queued.", "orange")
errorLog("payout not made " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": bank short, wanted " .. fmt(wanted) ..
", available " .. fmt(have) .. ". Request left queued.")
release()
return false, "short"
end
if got ~= net then
local ctx = ""
if GetRecentLines then ctx = GetRecentLines(8) or "" end
note("PAYOUT AMOUNT MISMATCH " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": sent " .. tostring(got) ..
" but recorded " .. fmt(net), "red")
errorLog("payout amount mismatch " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": game said " .. tostring(got) ..
", record says " .. fmt(net) .. ". Recent output:\n" .. ctx)
note("DO NOT retry this payout until " .. VAULT.owner .. " looks at it", "red")
return false, "unsettled"
end
local done = rpcRetry("casino_payout_paid", {
p_secret = secret(), p_id = row.id, p_net = row.net
})
if done and done.ok then
note("payout " .. fmt(net) .. " to " .. recipient .. " (" .. tostring(row.ref) .. ")", "lime")
return true
end
local why = done and tostring(done.error or "?") or "no answer"
note("PAYOUT SENT BUT NOT SETTLED " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " .. why .. " - run 'vault audit'", "red")
errorLog("payout sent in game but not settled " .. tostring(row.ref) .. ": " .. why)
return false, "unsettled"
end
function doWithdraw(speaker, rest)
local amount = amountOf(rest)
if not amount then
tell(speaker, "Usage: withdraw 5000")
return
end
if amount < VAULT.min_withdraw then
tell(speaker, "The smallest payout is " .. fmt(VAULT.min_withdraw) .. " gold.")
return
end
wait.make(function()
local result, err = rpcRetry("casino_request_payout_game", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker, p_amount = amount
})
if not result then
tell(speaker, "The vault is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.")
note("withdraw failed: " .. tostring(err), "red")
return
end
if not result.ok then
if result.error == "no_account" then
tell(speaker, "You don't have an account yet. Tell me 'login'.")
elseif result.error == "funds" then
tell(speaker, "You only have " .. fmt(result.gold) .. " gold in your account.")
elseif result.error == "amount" then
tell(speaker, "The smallest payout is " .. fmt(tonumber(result.min) or VAULT.min_withdraw) .. " gold.")
elseif result.error == "queue_full" then
tell(speaker, "You already have " .. tostring(result.open) .. " payouts waiting. Tell me 'pay' " ..
"to collect them, or cancel one on the site.")
else
tell(speaker, "Could not withdraw that. Try again shortly.")
end
return
end
-- They are talking to us, so they are online - but the transfer still needs
-- HukoDB in a bank, so the request waits if this one cannot be made.
local sent, why = settlePayout(result, result.character)
if sent then
tell(speaker, "Sent " .. fmt(result.net) .. " gold (" .. fmt(result.fee) .. " bank fee).")
elseif why == "unsettled" then
tell(speaker, "The gold went out but I could not record it (ref " .. tostring(result.ref) ..
"). Tell " .. VAULT.owner .. " so they can check the audit.")
elseif why == "notbank" then
tell(speaker, "I am not standing in a bank, so I cannot send it yet. Your " ..
fmt(result.amount) .. " gold is queued as " .. tostring(result.ref) ..
"; tell me 'pay' when I am at a bank.")
elseif why == "short" then
tell(speaker, "There is not enough gold in my bank account for that yet. Your " ..
fmt(result.amount) .. " gold is queued as " .. tostring(result.ref) ..
"; tell me 'pay' once it is topped up.")
else
tell(speaker, "I could not confirm the transfer, so I have not paid it. Your " ..
fmt(result.amount) .. " gold is queued as " .. tostring(result.ref) ..
" and nothing was refunded; ask me 'pay' again in a minute.")
end
end)
end
function doPay(speaker, rest)
wait.make(function()
local list = rpcRetry("casino_payout_list", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = speaker
})
if not list then
tell(speaker, "The vault is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.")
return
end
if not list.ok then
tell(speaker, "Could not read your payouts. Try again shortly.")
return
end
local wanted = trim(rest or ""):upper()
local paid, total, failed, lastWhy = 0, 0, 0, nil
for _, row in ipairs(list.payouts or {}) do
if wanted == "" or tostring(row.ref):upper() == wanted then
local sent, why = settlePayout(row, speaker)
if sent then
paid = paid + 1
total = total + (tonumber(row.net) or 0)
else
failed = failed + 1
lastWhy = why
-- Not being in a bank fails every request the same way, so stop
-- rather than bouncing off the bank once per payout.
if why == "notbank" then break end
end
end
end
if paid == 0 and failed == 0 then
tell(speaker, "Nothing is waiting to be paid.")
elseif paid == 0 and lastWhy == "notbank" then
tell(speaker, "I am not standing in a bank, so the bank refused. Your gold is still " ..
"queued (" .. failed .. " request" .. (failed == 1 and "" or "s") ..
") and nothing was refunded; ask me 'pay' when I am at one.")
elseif paid == 0 and lastWhy == "short" then
tell(speaker, "There is not enough gold in my bank account for that yet. Your gold is " ..
"still queued and nothing was refunded; ask " .. VAULT.owner .. " to top the bank up, " ..
"then 'pay' again.")
elseif paid == 0 then
tell(speaker, "I could not confirm the transfer, so nothing was paid. Your gold is still " ..
"queued (" .. failed .. " request" .. (failed == 1 and "" or "s") ..
") and nothing was refunded; ask me 'pay' again in a minute.")
elseif failed > 0 then
tell(speaker, "Sent " .. fmt(total) .. " gold for " .. paid .. " payout" .. (paid == 1 and "" or "s") ..
". " .. failed .. " could not be sent and are still queued; ask me 'pay' again at a bank.")
else
tell(speaker, "Sent " .. fmt(total) .. " gold for " .. paid .. " payout" .. (paid == 1 and "" or "s") .. ".")
end
end)
end
-- Operator: send every payout the site has queued, oldest first, from one
-- command. Each row still goes through settlePayout, so a request is only
-- marked paid once the game has confirmed the transfer.
local paying = false
function vaultPayAll()
if secret() == "" then note("No secret set. Use: vault secret <value>", "orange"); return end
if paying then note("A payout run is already in progress.", "orange"); return end
paying = true
wait.make(function()
local list, err = rpcRetry("casino_payout_queue", { p_secret = secret() })
if not list or not list.ok then
paying = false
local why = err or (list and list.error) or "no answer"
note("Could not read the payout queue: " .. tostring(why), "red")
errorLog("payout queue read failed: " .. tostring(why))
return
end
local rows = list.payouts or {}
if #rows == 0 then
paying = false
note("Nothing is waiting to be paid.", "lime")
return
end
local due = 0
for _, row in ipairs(rows) do due = due + (tonumber(row.net) or 0) end
note(#rows .. " payout" .. (#rows == 1 and "" or "s") .. " queued, " ..
fmt(due) .. " gold net. Sending now - this needs " .. VAULT.bot_name ..
" in a bank; anything that cannot be sent stays queued.", "white")
local paid, total, stopRef, stopWho, stopped = 0, 0, nil, nil, nil
for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
if stopped then break end
note("(" .. i .. "/" .. #rows .. ") " .. tostring(row.ref) .. " " ..
tostring(row.character) .. " " .. fmt(row.net), "silver")
local sent, why = settlePayout(row, row.character)
if sent then
paid = paid + 1
total = total + (tonumber(row.net) or 0)
if i < #rows then wait.time(1) end
else
stopped = why or "failed"
stopRef, stopWho = tostring(row.ref), tostring(row.character)
end
end
paying = false
if not stopped then
note("Paid " .. paid .. " payout" .. (paid == 1 and "" or "s") .. ", " ..
fmt(total) .. " gold. Queue is clear.", "lime")
elseif stopped == "notbank" then
note("STOPPED at " .. tostring(stopRef) .. " (" .. tostring(stopWho) ..
"): " .. VAULT.bot_name .. " is not standing in a bank, so the bank refused. " ..
"Nothing was paid and nothing was refunded - the whole queue is intact. " ..
paid .. " paid, " .. fmt(total) .. " gold. Walk to a bank and run 'payall' again.", "orange")
elseif stopped == "short" then
note("STOPPED at " .. tostring(stopRef) .. " (" .. tostring(stopWho) ..
"): there is not enough gold in the bank account for that one. Nothing was paid " ..
"for it and nothing was refunded; it is still queued. " .. paid .. " paid, " ..
fmt(total) .. " gold. Bank the carried gold ('vault bankall') and run 'payall' again.", "orange")
elseif stopped == "notsent" then
note("STOPPED at " .. tostring(stopRef) .. " (" .. tostring(stopWho) ..
"): the game did not confirm the transfer, so nothing was paid for it - " ..
"it is still queued and was NOT refunded. " .. paid .. " paid, " ..
fmt(total) .. " gold, and the rest are still queued too. Get " .. VAULT.bot_name ..
" into a bank and run 'payall' again; 'vault void " .. tostring(stopRef) ..
"' refunds that one by hand if it can never be sent.", "orange")
else
note("STOPPED at " .. tostring(stopRef) .. " (" .. tostring(stopWho) ..
"): the gold went out but the site did not record it. " .. paid ..
" paid, " .. fmt(total) .. " gold. Run 'vault audit' before paying " ..
"anything else.", "red")
end
if #queue > 0 then
note(#queue .. " deposit(s) are still in the outbox - run 'vault flush'.", "orange")
end
end)
end
-- Refund a request that can never be delivered (the character is gone, or the
-- operator waives it). Nothing refunds automatically any more: every other
-- failure leaves the request queued for a later run from a bank.
function vaultVoid(name, line, wildcards)
local ref = trim((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):upper()
if ref == "" then note("Usage: vault void WD-XXXXXX", "orange"); return end
if secret() == "" then note("No secret set.", "orange"); return end
wait.make(function()
local r = rpcRetry("casino_admin_ref", { p_secret = secret(), p_ref = ref })
if not r or not r.ok then
note("No record for " .. ref, "orange")
return
end
local p = r.payout
if type(p) ~= "table" then
note(ref .. " is not a payout ref.", "orange")
return
end
if p.status ~= "requested" then
note(ref .. " is already " .. tostring(p.status) .. "; nothing to void.", "orange")
return
end
note("Voiding " .. ref .. " - refunding " .. fmt(p.amount) .. " to " .. tostring(p.character), "silver")
failPayout({ id = p.id, ref = p.ref, amount = p.amount })
end)
end
local notified = {}
-- Assumes it is already running inside a wait.make coroutine.
local function pollPayouts()
if secret() == "" then return end
local result = rpc("casino_payout_queue", { p_secret = secret() })
if not result or not result.ok then return end
local now = os.time()
for _, row in ipairs(result.payouts or {}) do
local last = notified[row.id]
if not last or now - last > 600 then
notified[row.id] = now
tell(row.character, fmt(row.net) .. " gold is waiting (" .. tostring(row.ref) .."). Tell me 'pay'.")
rpc("casino_payout_notified", { p_secret = secret(), p_id = row.id })
end
end
end

local function shortDate(value)
if type(value) == "string" and #value >= 10 then return value:sub(1, 10) end
return "?"
end
local function formatEvent(e)
local meta = e.meta
if type(meta) ~= "table" then meta = {} end
local extra = ""
if e.action == "spin" or e.action == "jackpot" then
local reels = meta.reels
if type(reels) == "table" then extra = " [" .. table.concat(reels, "/") .. "]" end
extra = extra .. " bet " .. fmt(meta.bet or 0) .. " win " .. fmt(meta.win or 0)
elseif e.action == "deposit" then
extra = " via " .. tostring(meta.method or "?")
if type(meta.bank) == "string" and meta.bank ~= "" then extra = extra .. " at " .. meta.bank end
elseif e.action == "withdraw" then
extra = " net " .. fmt(meta.net or 0)
elseif e.action == "deposit_held" then
extra = " held " .. fmt(meta.held or 0)
end
local when = ""
if type(e.at) == "string" and #e.at >= 19 then when = e.at:sub(12, 19) end
local delta = tonumber(e.delta) or 0
return when .. " " .. tostring(e.action) .. " " .. (delta > 0 and "+" or "") ..
fmt(delta) .. " -> " .. fmt(e.balance or 0) .. extra ..
(e.ref and (" " .. tostring(e.ref)) or "")
end

function doRefund(speaker)
wait.make(function()
local result = rpcRetry("casino_take_pending", {

})

end

return
end
local gross = math.floor(tonumber(result.amount) or 0)

if result.method ~= "give" then fee = feeFor(gross) end
local net = gross - fee
if net < 1 then
tell(speaker, "The bank fee is bigger than what I'm holding. Ask " .. VAULT.owner .. " in game.")

end

tell(result.character, "Returning " .. fmt(net) .. " gold" .. suffix .. ".")

end)

-- ============================================================
-- GOLD ARRIVING
-- ============================================================
-- Pull the matched phrase out of the original line so names keep their case.
local function grab(line, lowpat)
local start, finish = line:lower():find(lowpat)
if not start then return nil end
return line:sub(start, finish)
end
-- Chat, tells and emotes are echoed into the same window as game output, so
-- anything a player can type reaches the money triggers. A real credit line
-- is one unquoted sentence that starts with the sender name; a quoted line,
-- a channel line, or a line that begins with someone speaking is never a
-- credit. Without this, "say Mallory gives you 1000000 gold" credited gold.
local CHAT_VERBS = {
says = true, say = true, tells = true, tell = true, asks = true, ask = true,
exclaims = true, exclaim = true, shouts = true, shout = true, yells = true,
yell = true, whispers = true, whisper = true, emotes = true, emote = true,
sings = true, sing = true, mutters = true, mutter = true, replies = true,
reply = true, answers = true, answer = true
}
local function isChatLine(line)
local s = tostring(line or "")
if s:find('"', 1, true) then return true end
if s:match("^%s*%[") then return true end
local verb = s:match("^%s*%S+%s+([%a]+)")
if verb and CHAT_VERBS[verb:lower()] then return true end
return false
end
-- Anchored on purpose. These patterns used to match anywhere in the line,
-- which is what let echoed chat mint gold.
local function parseGold(line)
local s = trim(tostring(line or ""))
local sender, amount = s:match("^([%w]+) gives you ([%d,]+) gold")
if sender then return sender, amount, "give" end
sender, amount = s:match("^([%w]+) has given you ([%d,]+) gold")
if sender then return sender, amount, "give" end
sender, amount = s:match("^([%w]+) transferred ([%d,]+) gold to you")
if sender then return sender, amount, "bank" end
amount, sender = s:match("^[Yy]ou receive ([%d,]+) gold from ([%w]+)")
if sender then return sender, amount, "bank" end
amount, sender = s:match("^[Bb]ank transfer of ([%d,]+) gold from ([%w]+)")
if sender then return sender, amount, "bank" end
return nil
end
function vaultGoldLine(name, line)
if not line then return end
if isChatLine(line) then
if VAULT.debug then note("ignored chat line near a gold trigger: " .. line, "grey") end
return
end
local sender, amountText, method = parseGold(line)
if VAULT.debug then note("gold line: " .. line, "grey") end
if not sender then return end
local amount = amountOf(amountText)
if not amount then return end
if sender:lower() == VAULT.bot_name:lower() then return end
-- The game may print two lines for one transfer; count it once.
local key = sender:lower() .. "|" .. tostring(amount)
local now = os.time()
if seen[key] and now - seen[key] < 5 then
remember("gold DUPLICATE ignored: " .. key)
if VAULT.debug then note("duplicate gold line ignored: " .. key, "grey") end
return
end
remember("gold " .. tostring(sender) .. " " .. fmt(amount) .. " via " .. tostring(method))
seen[key] = now
for oldKey, stamp in pairs(seen) do
if now - stamp > 600 then seen[oldKey] = nil end
end
depositEvent(sender, amount, method)
end
-- A bank transfer lands straight in our bank account, so it is credited
-- without running "bank deposit" (the gold is already banked).
function vaultBankCredit(name, line, wildcards)
if not line then return end
if isChatLine(line) then return end
-- The line has to begin with the name the trigger caught. Echoed text
-- cannot satisfy this even if a pattern ever loosens again.
local sender = wildcards and wildcards[1]
if sender and trim(line):sub(1, #sender):lower() ~= sender:lower() then return end
local amount = amountOf(wildcards and wildcards[2])
local bank = trim(wildcards and wildcards[3] or "")
if not sender or not amount then return end
if sender:lower() == VAULT.bot_name:lower() then return end
-- No dedupe here: the game prints this line exactly once per transfer,
-- and two transfers of the same amount seconds apart are legitimate.
remember("bank " .. tostring(sender) .. " " .. fmt(amount) ..
(bank ~= "" and (" at " .. bank) or ""))
if VAULT.debug then note("bank credit line: " .. line, "grey") end
depositEvent(sender, amount, "bank", bank)
end
function depositEvent(sender, amount, method, bank)
wait.make(function()
local ref = newRef(sender)
local result, err = rpcRetry("casino_deposit", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = sender, p_amount = amount,
p_method = method, p_ref = ref, p_bank = ((bank ~= nil and bank ~= "") and bank or nil)
})
if not result then
queueAdd(sender, amount, method, ref, bank)
tell(sender, "I have your " .. fmt(amount) .. " gold and will add it as soon as the vault answers.")
note("deposit queued (" .. tostring(err) .. "): " .. sender .. " " .. fmt(amount), "orange")
errorLog("deposit queued for " .. sender .. " " .. fmt(amount) .. ": " .. tostring(err))
return
end
if result.status == "credited" then
tell(sender, fmt(amount) .. " gold added to " .. result.character .. "'s account.")
if method ~= "bank" then Send("bank deposit " .. tostring(amount)) end
note("credited " .. fmt(amount) .. " to " .. result.character ..
((bank ~= nil and bank ~= "") and (" (" .. bank .. ")") or ""), "lime")
else
-- A bank refund is paid out of the bank, so bank this gold. A give
-- refund is paid by hand, so that gold stays on us.
if method ~= "give" then Send("bank deposit " .. tostring(amount)) end
tell(sender, "You don't have an account. Tell me 'login' to make one, or 'refund' to get it back (bank fee deducted).")
note("held " .. fmt(amount) .. " for " .. sender .. " (no account)", "orange")
end
end)
end
function vaultGiveSent(name, line)
lastGive = nil
end
-- A give refund only works in the same room. If the player walked off the
-- gold is still ours, so put it back in the holding pot.
function vaultGiveFailed(name, line)
if not lastGive then return end
if os.time() - (lastGive.at or 0) > 90 then lastGive = nil; return end
local low = line and line:lower() or ""
local named = low:find(lastGive.character:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
local generic = low:find("aren't here", 1, true) or low:find("isn't here", 1, true)
if not named and not generic then return end
local pending = lastGive
lastGive = nil
wait.make(function()
local result = rpcRetry("casino_hold", {
p_secret = secret(), p_character = pending.character, p_amount = pending.amount,
p_method = "give", p_ref = pending.ref
})
if result and result.ok then
tell(pending.character, "You moved out of reach, so I'm holding " ..
fmt(pending.amount) .. " gold. Tell me 'refund' when you are back, or 'login'.")
note("re-held " .. fmt(pending.amount) .. " for " .. pending.character, "orange")
else
note("COULD NOT RE-HOLD " .. fmt(pending.amount) .. " for " .. pending.character .. " - check the vault by hand!", "red")
errorLog("re-hold failed for " .. pending.character .. " " .. fmt(pending.amount))
end
end)
end

function vaultCommand(rest)
local text = trim(rest or "")
local cmd, arg = text:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
cmd = cmd and cmd:lower() or ""
arg = trim(arg or "")
local first, second = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)$")
local w = first and { first, second or "" } or { arg }
local handlers = {
secret = vaultSetSecret, status = vaultStatus, test = vaultTest,
debug = vaultToggleDebug, flush = vaultFlushNow, audit = vaultAudit,
verify = vaultVerify, check = vaultCheck, spins = vaultSpins,
ref = vaultRef, errors = vaultErrors, log = vaultErrors,
bankall = vaultBankAll, last = vaultLast, help = vaultHelpLocal,
payall = vaultPayAll, void = vaultVoid
}
local fn = handlers[cmd]
if not fn then vaultHelpLocal(); return end
fn("vault", "vault " .. text, w)
end
function vaultSetSecret(name, line, wildcards)
local value = trim(wildcards and wildcards[1])
if value == "" then note("Usage: vault secret <value>", "orange"); return end
SECRET = value
SetVariable("bot_secret", value)
SaveState()
note("Secret set (" .. #value .. " characters).", "lime")
end

local held = secret()
local shown = "empty"
if held ~= "" then shown = held:sub(1, 4) .. "..." .. held:sub(-4) end
note("Secret held: " .. #held .. " chars, " .. shown, "silver")
if held == "" then note("Nothing to send. Run: vault secret <value>", "orange"); return end
wait.make(function()
local r, err = rpc("casino_verify_chain", { p_secret = held })
if not r then
note("No answer from Supabase: " .. tostring(err), "red")
errorLog("selftest failed: " .. tostring(err))

end
if r.ok then
note("Server accepted the secret. Chain: " .. (r.valid and "intact" or "BROKEN") ..
", events: " .. tostring(r.checked), "lime")
else
note("Server said: " .. tostring(r.error) .. " - the secret does not match casino_config", "red")
end
end)
end
function vaultStatus()
local secretState = (secret() ~= "") and "set" or "MISSING"
note("Build " .. BUILD .. " | Secret: " .. secretState .. " | outbox: " .. #queue .. " | debug: " ..

local r = rpc("casino_vault_status", {})
if r then
